mu_name_from: _enum.h:1513 MODEL_THUNDER_BLADE = MODEL_SWORD + 18, loaded from Item/Sword19.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:622); OpenMU Version095d Weapons.cs:112.
why_this_one: Icarus's Crusts carry it: the Mega Crust at +5 and the Alpha Crust at +9, each with a Legendary Shield (ZzzCharacter.cpp:13588-13611), as the Golden Crust does (:14895-14904). docs/icarus-port.md Part A 4.3.

stats.from: OpenMU Version095d Weapons.cs:112: CreateWeapon(0, 18, 0, 23, 2, 3, true, "Thunder Blade", 105, 140, 168, 40, 86, 0, 0, 180, 50, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1) -- drop 105, 140-168, speed 40, durability 86, 180 strength and 50 agility, the Magic Gladiator's alone.
stats.note: Built as a monster's arm, as the statue weapons are: OpenMU's row is the Magic Gladiator's only, a class we do not have (the Storm Crow set was skipped for the same reason, the user 2026-10-06), so nobody wears it and it does not drop. Its damage, requirements and class are left out so the card says none.

stance_from: Held in the right hand with the Legendary Shield in the left (Weapon[0] and Weapon[1], ZzzCharacter.cpp:13595-13597), so held as a one-handed sword.
sheet_from: Data/Item/Msword.OZJ (128x256: a steel blade in a blue-black serrated sheath, a grey ridged hilt), its one sheet, 194 triangles in one mesh. Decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_overrides_note: As every flat blade passed in the studio: steel's own 0.2 mirrors the grass black.
glow_note: No ItemObjectAttribute and no RenderPartObject arm: a solid sword. PartObjectColor2 gives it Color 0 (ZzzObject.cpp:6838-6841), the refinement tint's. Held, MuMain hangs a breathing blue BITMAP_SHINY + 1 at (0, -20, 15) in the hand, Scale sin(WorldTime*0.004)*0.3+0.3 (+1), lit (0.2, 0.2, 1) times it, and three BITMAP_JOINT_THUNDER sub 10 from there to (0, -133, 7), 20-32 wide (ZzzCharacter.cpp:10238-10256); the spark is built in fx/held_lights, the thunder is not.
rig_note: export-rig --actions=all: one bone, one action of one key; nothing moves, no rig kept.
